name: Saotome Nikichi
source:
The manager of Arcobaleno.
He has a severe, realist personality that doesn't suit his cute looks.
He's the only one who can control the owner [url=/c42198]Ryuunosuke[/url] when he does outrageous things, he's the true backbone of the business.
